map.由谢才系数、水力半径与底坡求流速: Find Velocity from the Chezy Coefficient, Hydraulic Radius and Bed Slope
map.输入谢才系数 C、水力半径 R、底坡 S，求流速。: Enter the Chezy coefficient C, hydraulic radius R and bed slope S to find the velocity.
map.V = C·√(R·S)（R 为水力半径，S 为水力坡度/底坡，C 为谢才系数）: V = C·√(R·S), where R is the hydraulic radius, S the hydraulic or bed slope, and C the Chezy coefficient.
a canal with C=50, hydraulic radius R=0.5 m and bed slope S=0.01 gives V=50×√(0.5×0.01)=50×0.07071≈3.54 m/s; with a flow area A=2 m² the discharge is Q=V·A≈7.07 m³/s.
